summary: Completed testing of Platform Donation feature for Free/Pro/Premium plans. All 8 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend UI correctly shows mandatory donation for Free plan events (no $0 option) with warning message. Platform donation is properly included in order total and sent to backend.
critical_code_review_comments: Platform donation UI correctly implemented in EventView.tsx (lines 1032-1102) with Heart icon and gradient styling
Mandatory donation for Free plan: $0 option hidden, warning message shown, asterisk indicator present
Optional donation for Pro/Premium: $0 option available when hidePlatformDonation is false
EventBuilder.tsx (lines 553-571) correctly shows toggle only for Pro/Premium plans

Backend stripeController.js properly handles platformDonationAmount: adds as separate Stripe line item (lines 114-128), includes in application fee (line 197), tracks separately in registration (line 239)
types.ts correctly defines hidePlatformDonation in Event type (line 337) and platformDonationAmount in Registration type (line 465)
Order total calculation in EventView.tsx (line 341) correctly adds platformDonationAmount to total
test_credentials: None required - tested public endpoints and UI
